scripts.//dev: Run the Worker locally against local D1/R2.
scripts.//deploy: Push the Worker to Cloudflare. CI does this; by hand only to hotfix.
scripts.//ensure:bindings: CI ONLY: create D1/R2 if missing, patch database_id into wrangler.toml, apply migrations. Needs CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.
scripts.//migrate: Apply pending migrations to the REMOTE db using your wrangler login, no token. Add -- --list to preview.
scripts.//types: Regenerate binding types. Rarely needed; Env is hand-written.
scripts.//typecheck: Type-check src/. Tests are excluded on purpose, see tsconfig.
scripts.//test: Run the Worker tests. Zero test dependencies: Node strips the types itself.
scripts.//photos: INTERACTIVE photo browser. j/k move, o open in browser, d delete, q quit. Add -- --all to include deleted rows.
scripts.//backup: Dump every table to backups/meowmap-<ts>.json. Add -- --photos to also download the images.
scripts.//restore: REPLACE the tables from a backup file, keeping ids. Dry run unless you add -- --apply.
scripts.//purge: Delete data. Add -- --sighting N / --cat N / --before YYYY-MM-DD / --all, then --apply.
scripts.//wipe: DESTROYS EVERYTHING: every sighting, cat and photo. No confirmation prompt.
scripts.//reconcile: Compare the app_meta cost counters against the real bucket. Dry run unless you add -- --apply.
scripts.//gc: Delete the photos queued in r2_gc_queue, then correct the counters.
